title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
provenance: Reported by Bipolaire (highball-db#108, 2026-09-17), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2 as entered, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Wine's Direct3D, rated 4 of 5 (playable, minor issues) after 55 minutes. Michael-Liendo (highball-db#280, 2026-10-02), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, the environment on DXVK, rated 4 of 5 after 60 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. Yas1ne (highball-db#853, 2026-11-01), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-crossover26.3-r9, WineD3D by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 5 of 5 after 1 minutes: a one minute look.
notes: Reported playable twice: 55 minutes on Wine's own Direct3D (M4 Pro, engine r3) and 60 minutes on an M4 with the environment on DXVK (engine r17). The second report saw black line segments flicker in a grid across the picture on Wine's Direct3D, which the game's Definition and Shadow settings did not change, brief stutter when turning the camera until -availablevidmem 4000 was added to the game's launch options, and a DualSense that the game only saw after the two WineBus values Highball's Controllers through SDL tweak sets. The row now points at DXVK, the mode of the longer and more detailed report, for a 2008 Direct3D 9 game. Needs the Rockstar Games Launcher for sign-in on Steam. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Black line segments in a grid pattern flicker across the picture in play on Wine's Direct3D (reported on an M4, engine r17)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game's Definition and Shadow settings do not change it
knownIssues.fix: Set the game's graphics mode to DXVK, where the same reporter played an hour

knownIssues.symptom: Brief stutter when moving the camera (reported on an M4, engine r17)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game budgets video memory from what the driver reports
knownIssues.fix: The reporter added -availablevidmem 4000 to the game's launch options in Steam and the stutter stopped. Not applied by the row, one report so far

knownIssues.symptom: A DualSense controller is not seen by the game (reported on an M4)
knownIssues.cause: Wine's controller driver reads the pad through the Mac's raw HID path as well as SDL, and some games only see it through SDL
knownIssues.fix: Apply the Controllers through SDL tweak from the environment's recipes (it sets Enable SDL and DisableHidraw under HKCU\Software\Wine\WineBus, the two values the reporter set by hand), then restart the environment
